continuity_scope: Tyranny original base-game release, English PC/Mac/Linux release boundary (10 November 2016). This pass uses only the named first-party campaign and game-page witnesses. It excludes later DLC, edition/package variants, patches, ports, localization variants, and all non-game continuities.
work_or_witnesses: Official Tyranny campaign page: The Story
coverage_rule: All stable named individual dramatic agents directly named and functionally described in the selected first-party campaign premise: Kyros the Overlord and Tunon the Adjudicator. The player-created Fatebinder is explicitly excluded as an avatar role. No other named individual receives a record without a claim-level official profile or direct in-game text locator.
omissions: The Fatebinder/player avatar, including player-selected judgment, loyalty, reputation, alliances, deaths, and endings.
All named and unnamed NPCs, companions, leaders, enemies, and supernatural figures not directly described at claim level in the selected official witnesses.
Kyros' armies, their factions, the Tiers, law, magic, reputations, edicts, artifacts, locations, and mechanics as character nodes.
Bastard's Wound and all other DLC, later patches, edition/package and platform variants, localizations, adaptations, fan/community/wiki material, walkthroughs, and secondary character directories.
uncertainties: The campaign page is a premise/marketing witness, not an exhaustive cast directory or a direct in-game dialogue, quest, or codex archive; the coverage is deliberately narrow.
Political and legal framing is reported as the official campaign premise, not as independently verified in-world fact.
The Fatebinder's choices and faction reputations make allegiance, justice, relationships, deaths, and endings branch-dependent; none is universalized here.
No relationship is recorded: the selected text links Tunon to the excluded Fatebinder role, but does not supply a direct named-character-to-named-character relation for the two included individuals.
English wording is the only reviewed localization. DLC/patch behavior and other language versions remain separate evidence questions.
evidence_basis: First-party Obsidian Entertainment game and official Tyranny campaign pages only. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, community source, review, walkthrough, or secondary database is used as canonical evidence.
